headline: China extends to January pause on export ban to US of key minerals for semiconductors
summary: China's Commerce Ministry extended its suspension of export bans on various minerals and metals to the United States until January 27. The minerals are important for semiconductors.
why: Critical minerals such as gallium and germanium feed chip supply chains, so export curbs affect semiconductor makers and US-China trade.
why_moved: The pause delays a possible ban on mineral exports to the US, reducing near-term supply risk for semiconductor supply chains.
original_headline: China extiende a enero pausa al veto de exportaciones a EU de minerales clave para semiconductores
